subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should pending groups remain completely silent until an authenticated owner approves them, or may their messages enter a separately isolated observation-only agent context before approval?
rationale: The choice determines the authorization boundary, state model, notification routing, and whether hostile unapproved content can reach model context or tools; current behavior and repository policy do not settle it.

options.title: Silent pending admission
options.body: Create owner notification and approve/reject state, but drop all pending-group content until approval.

options.title: Isolated reader mode
options.body: Permit pre-approval content only through a separately specified tool-less, non-persistent, non-replying observation boundary.

options.title: Keep explicit allowlists
options.body: Retain current admission semantics and pursue only narrower group-join notification, warn, or leave capabilities.

recommendation.title: Silent pending admission
recommendation.body: Create owner notification and approve/reject state, but drop all pending-group content until approval.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the existing product/security review and is the clearest available owner for resolving the issue-wide contract rather than one channel implementation.
